description: API layer: GlobalExceptionMiddleware, AuditActionAttribute + AuditActionFilter, and all 9 controllers. Depends on FEAT-001 (entities/repos) and FEAT-002 (services, DTOs, interfaces). This FEAT is the top of the dependency stack.
steps: 1. Create DCDSS/Middleware/AuditActionAttribute.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Middleware. [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)] public sealed class AuditActionAttribute : Attribute { public string ActionName { get; } public string? IdArgument { get; } public AuditActionAttribute(string actionName, string? idArgument = null) { ActionName = actionName; IdArgument = idArgument; } }

2. Create DCDSS/Middleware/GlobalExceptionMiddleware.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Middleware. Constructor(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware> logger). InvokeAsync: try { await _next(ctx); } catch (Exception ex) { await HandleAsync(ctx, ex, logger); }. HandleAsync: generate traceId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? ctx.TraceIdentifier. Switch on exception type: NotFoundException → 404 "Not Found" (log Warning); ConflictException → 409 "Conflict" (log Warning); BusinessRuleException → 400 "Business Rule Violation" (log Warning); UnauthorizedAccessException → 401 "Unauthorized" (log Information); DbUpdateException → 409 "Data Conflict" generic detail (log Error); else → 500 "Internal Server Error" (log Error with stack trace — stack trace in log only, never in response). In Development (inject IWebHostEnvironment or check env via ctor): include ex.Message in Detail; in production omit it. All responses: ctx.Response.ContentType = "application/problem+json"; write JSON ProblemDetails { status, title, detail (env-conditional), instance=ctx.Request.Path, extensions={traceId} }. Use System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.

3. Create DCDSS/Middleware/AuditActionFilter.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Middleware. Implements IAsyncActionFilter. Constructor(IAuditLogService auditService, ICurrentUserService currentUser). OnActionExecutionAsync:
    1. Read AuditActionAttribute from context.ActionDescriptor.EndpointMetadata. If absent, call next() and return.
    2. userId = currentUser.GetUserId() (nullable).
    3. ActionExecutedContext executedCtx = null!; try { executedCtx = await next(); } finally { if executedCtx != null) { await WriteAuditAsync(...); } }
    4. In WriteAuditAsync: success = executedCtx.Exception == null || executedCtx.ExceptionHandled. effectiveAction = (attr.ActionName=="LOGIN" && !success) ? "LOGIN_FAILED" : attr.ActionName.
    5. Build Details dictionary (System.Text.Json serialize):
       - If ActionName=="LOGIN" or =="LOGIN_FAILED": extract LoginDto from action args (context.ActionArguments), details = { "username": dto.Username, "success": success }.
       - Else if attr.IdArgument != null and context.ActionArguments.ContainsKey(attr.IdArgument): details = { "entityId": context.ActionArguments[attr.IdArgument], "success": success }.
       - Else (POST create — no idArgument): if executedCtx.Result is ObjectResult or and its Value implements IAuditableResult: details = { "entityId": ((IAuditableResult)objectResult.Value).EntityId, "success": success }. Else details = { "entityId": null, "success": success }.
       - CDS_EVALUATE special: if ActionName=="CDS_EVALUATE": try extract CdsEvaluationRequestDto from action args, details = { "patientId": dto.PatientId, "success": success }.
    6. string detailsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(details).
    7. await auditService.LogAsync(userId, effectiveAction, detailsJson). NOTE: exception must NOT be set to ExceptionHandled — let GlobalExceptionMiddleware handle it.

4. Create DCDSS/Controllers/AuthController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/auth")]. Constructor(IAuthService authService). Actions:
    - POST register: [HttpPost("register"), Authorize(Roles="Administrator"), AuditAction("REGISTER")]. Parameter: [FromBody] RegisterDto dto. Calls authService.RegisterAsync(dto). Returns Ok(result).
    - POST login: [HttpPost("login"), AllowAnonymous, AuditAction("LOGIN")]. Parameter: [FromBody] LoginDto dto. Calls authService.LoginAsync(dto). Returns Ok(result).

5. Create DCDSS/Controllers/MedicalRecordsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/medical-records")]. Constructor(IMedicalRecordService service). Actions:
    - POST "": [HttpPost, Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse"), AuditAction("CREATE_MEDICAL_RECORD")]. Parameter: [FromBody] CreateMedicalRecordDto dto. Calls service.CreateAsync(dto). Returns Created($"/api/medical-records/{result.RecordId}", result).

6. Create DCDSS/Controllers/PatientsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/patients")]. Constructor(IPatientService service). Actions:
    - GET "": [HttpGet, Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse,LaboratoryStaff")]. Parameters: [FromQuery] int page=1, [FromQuery] int pageSize=20, [FromQuery] string? search. Returns Ok(await service.GetPagedAsync(page, pageSize, search)).
    - POST "": [HttpPost, Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse"), AuditAction("CREATE_PATIENT")]. [FromBody] CreatePatientDto dto. Returns Created($"/api/patients/{result.PatientId}", result).
    - GET {id}: [HttpGet("{id:int}"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse,LaboratoryStaff"), AuditAction("VIEW_PATIENT", "id")]. Returns Ok or NotFound.
    - PUT {id}: [HttpPut("{id:int}"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse"), AuditAction("UPDATE_PATIENT", "id")]. [FromBody] UpdatePatientDto dto. Returns Ok(result).

7. Create DCDSS/Controllers/CdsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/cds")]. Constructor(ICdsEngine cdsEngine). Actions:
    - POST evaluate: [HttpPost("evaluate"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse"), AuditAction("CDS_EVALUATE")]. [FromBody] CdsEvaluationRequestDto dto. Returns Ok(await cdsEngine.EvaluateAsync(dto)).

8. Create DCDSS/Controllers/LaboratoryController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/laboratory")]. Constructor(ILabService labService, ICurrentUserService currentUser). Actions:
    - POST order: [HttpPost("order"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse"), AuditAction("CREATE_LAB_ORDER")]. [FromBody] OrderLabTestDto dto. int userId = currentUser.GetUserId() ?? 0. Returns Created($"/api/laboratory/results/{result.ResultId}", result).
    - PUT results/{id}: [HttpPut("results/{id:int}"), Authorize(Roles="LaboratoryStaff"), AuditAction("UPDATE_LAB_RESULT", "id")]. [FromBody] UpdateLabResultDto dto. Returns Ok(result).
    - GET patient/{patientId}: [HttpGet("patient/{patientId:int}"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse,LaboratoryStaff"), AuditAction("VIEW_LAB_HISTORY", "patientId")]. Returns Ok(results).

9. Create DCDSS/Controllers/MedicationsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/medications")]. Constructor(IMedicationService service, ICurrentUserService currentUser). Actions:
    - POST "": [HttpPost, Authorize(Roles="Doctor"), AuditAction("CREATE_MEDICATION")]. [FromBody] CreateMedicationDto dto. int userId = currentUser.GetUserId() ?? 0. Returns Created($"/api/medications/{result.Medication.MedicationId}", result).
    - PUT {id}/discontinue: [HttpPut("{id:int}/discontinue"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor"), AuditAction("DISCONTINUE_MEDICATION", "id")]. Returns Ok(result).

10. Create DCDSS/Controllers/AppointmentsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/appointments")]. Constructor(IAppointmentService service). Actions:
    - POST "": [HttpPost, Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse,Administrator"), AuditAction("CREATE_APPOINTMENT")]. [FromBody] CreateAppointmentDto dto. Returns Created($"/api/appointments/{result.AppointmentId}", result).
    - GET doctor/{doctorId}: [HttpGet("doctor/{doctorId:int}"), Authorize(Roles="Doctor,Nurse,Administrator")]. Returns Ok(await service.GetByDoctorAsync(doctorId)).

11. Create DCDSS/Controllers/ReportsController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/reports")]. Constructor(IReportService reportService). Actions:
    - GET monthly-stats: [HttpGet("monthly-stats"), Authorize(Roles="Administrator")]. [FromQuery] int? month, [FromQuery] int? year. Resolve defaults: month ??= DateTime.UtcNow.Month; year ??= DateTime.UtcNow.Year. Returns Ok(await reportService.GetMonthlyStatsAsync(month.Value, year.Value)).

12. Create DCDSS/Controllers/AuditController.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Controllers. [ApiController, Route("api/audit")]. Constructor(IAuditLogRepository auditRepo). Actions:
    - GET "": [HttpGet, Authorize(Roles="Administrator")]. [FromQuery] int page=1, [FromQuery] int pageSize=20. Clamp: page = Math.Max(1, page); pageSize = Math.Clamp(pageSize, 1, 100). var (items, total) = await auditRepo.GetPagedAsync(page, pageSize). Map to IList<AuditLogDto>. Return Ok(new PagedResult<AuditLogDto> { Items=mapped, Total=total, Page=page, PageSize=pageSize }).
acceptance_criteria: All 9 controllers compile with correct [Route], [HttpGet/Post/Put], [Authorize(Roles=...)], and [AuditAction(...)] attributes.
AuthController login action has [AllowAnonymous] and no [Authorize].
GlobalExceptionMiddleware maps all 5 exception types to correct HTTP status codes.
AuditActionFilter uses try/finally, sets effectiveAction to LOGIN_FAILED when login fails, never sets ExceptionHandled.
LaboratoryController POST order reads orderedByUserId from ICurrentUserService.
MedicationsController POST reads currentUserId from ICurrentUserService.

findings: Program.cs registers AddDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> only (no AddDbContext), consistent with FEAT-001 guidance. AuditLogService uses IDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> for isolation. AuditActionFilter is registered as a scoped service and added via options.Filters.AddService<AuditActionFilter>() so it participates in DI. GlobalExceptionMiddleware is registered FIRST in the pipeline. FallbackPolicy requires authenticated user; [AllowAnonymous] on login is explicit. JwtSettingsValidator will throw on startup if SigningKey is placeholder or < 32 bytes — appsettings.json must be updated with real values before running. AdminSeeder runs on startup and skips if an Administrator already exists. All 9 controllers compile with correct [Route], [HttpGet/Post/Put], [Authorize(Roles=...)], and [AuditAction(...)] attributes. 0 errors, 0 warnings on dotnet build.
